article.title: Conectores como gestión de turno
article.part: Sintaxis discursiva compleja — 복합 담화 통사
article.chapter: Cadenas de cláusulas y suspensión — 절 연쇄와 문장 미완결

claims.summary: For the translated-script corpus studied by Kim, suspended Korean nuntey clauses often supplied background information and avoided direct denial; the result is limited to this corpus and does not establish a universal turn-management rule.

locator.section: Kim (2019), abstract, lines 98–105; detailed result, lines 255–262.

links.notes: The article reports the measured suspended-clause patterns and explicitly limits them to translated English movie scripts.
